acceptanceCriteria.text: `readTool` returns no dedupe/content identity when the content used for inspection differs from the bytes actually authorized/read.
The same-size + restored-mtime rewrite case fails closed; stat metadata must not substitute for content verification.
The implementation preserves #889's descriptor-bound path confinement and does not reintroduce separate path-based read authority.
Identity remains present for an unchanged file and is derived from the exact content actually returned/projected.
The two existing `dedupe.test.ts` regressions pass without weakening their assertions.
Focused tests cover in-place rewrite, same-size/mtime-restored rewrite, unchanged content, and any relevant bounded-range path.
`pnpm test` passes on the resulting branch.

issue.title: fix(context): drop dedupe identity when authorized read content changes after inspection
